Episode details
Available for 29 days
There's plenty of bad blood ahead of Celtic's trip to Tynecastle, but can Hearts turn their impressive attacking form into another big result? Charlotte Cohen is joined by former striker Cillian Sheridan and journalist Ewan Murray to preview a potentially explosive encounter. Can high-flying Falkirk cause Rangers problems at Ibrox? Will Hibs build on their long-awaited home win when they visit struggling Motherwell? There's also a look at Aberdeen's encouraging start under their new manager, Dundee United's impressive form and a crucial clash between St Mirren and Kilmarnock. Is the pressure mounting on Neil McCann? 01:14 — Hearts and Celtic's European fortunes 05:03 — Hearts v Celtic: Tynecastle showdown 11:28 — Motherwell v Hibs: Who needs the win more? 16:28 — Rangers face flying Falkirk 18:09 — Aberdeen's revival and Dundee United's form 21:37 — St Mirren v Kilmarnock: Pressure mounting
